balls.text: short in length, on middle and leg, turned to midwicket for a single
pushes this out to mid-on for a single
backs away but Parnell follows him with a shortish delivery and cramps him for room. PK stabs it to midwicket
slips in the slower one this time and it goes past the waft and between the leg stump and the batsman
tries the bouncer on the hat-trick ball but PK just about manages to arch back and sway away from the line of fire
Chitnis swings this slower one to long-on where Abhishek pouches it. The camera pans to Priety Zinta who anxiously follows the trajectory of that ball and winces at the result. Cho chad.
lovely slower one, fullish on the middle, sliced off the edge just over backward point
moves outside leg and swats a shortish delivery to mid-on

Around waist-high full toss and another one goes down very tamely. Ryan can't get any power behind this shot and Yuvraj takes a dolly at covers. The umpires have some doubt about the height of that full toss. Whether it was above waist? The replays show that it was just below or around the waist high. Out is the correct  verdict. Ryan shakes his head and goes away.
full and outside off, Ryan backs away and has a go at it but no wood on leather
fuller just outside off, jabbed to the off side.
short in length and he swivels to pull it high and gets the placement to right of long-on
Yuvraj almost drops it! Ugly shot! Mandeep tries a slog and the ball lobs to covers. The ball pops out of Yuvraj's palms but he takes it on the rebound
slower one this time and Mandeep can't get bat on ball
Ouch Parnell hurls a bouncer and the batsman is again late on the pull. The ball flies off the top edge and crashes into his helmet grill
Dropped by Manish Pandey What a clanger! The flat-batted went completely awry and the ball ballooned to mid-off. Manish waited. And waited. And then clanged it.
banged in short and he sways away from the line
backs away and carves it uppishly but short of the sweeper cover
moves outside leg and forces it to sweeper cover
tries to go down the track but Rahul isn't a bowler that you can do too easily. You have to time your jump properly. Rahul got this to skid on from short of length and the batsman just stabs it awya
chops this to backward point for a single
Ooh that some how missed the leg stump! Rahul can't believe it. Chitnis  tried to drag this from outside off to the leg side and edged it just past the leg stump
skids on towards off, the batsman edges it to his pad
tries to pull this but ends up swatting it to square-leg
works this to midwicket for a single
Full pitched delivery and DK picks out long-on. He trudges off back to the hut. Punjab meander along to nowhere
banged in short and Mandeep pulls it to left of deep midwicket where Bhuvneshwar lunges out to make a neat stop
leans across to square drive this full delivery to deep point region
rolls off the pad to square-leg
manages to stab this to left of backward point
just outside off, sliced down to third man
stays back to jab this to backward point

the man who bowled SRT for a duck in domestic cricket, his very first duck too, gets David. It's a short of length delivery straightening outside off and David Hussey gets an edge on the attempted cut
he is bit like Robin, isn't he? Iffy shot selections. He tries a paddle sweep and just about manages to stab it to the on side
Finally, some action from the batsmen. DK went down on his knee to cream this through wide mid-off
quicker, skids low on the pads, turned through midwicket for couple of runs
slower, comes in with the arm, David edges the poke to his pad
sweeps uppishly but it lands safely before long-leg
forces this towards cowcorner for couple of runs
Robin misses run out He missed running out SRT the other night. It was tapped to the off side. Very close. Robin dashed across and threw but missed out again!
on the middle stump line, slower, turned past square-leg
on the middle stump line, worked around to midwicket for a single
runs this down to third man for a single
Inside edge! Marsh tries to break free but was done in by the slower one. He fetched it from outside off and tried to drag it to the on side but was beaten by the lack of pace.
on the leg stump line, Marsh taps it close on the off side.
leans forward to push this to covers for a single
in the zone outside off stump, swing and a miss
stays back to punch this to sweeper cover. Another tight over from Rahul
too full to cut but Dk tries and is beaten. It skid off a length outside off and Robin collects. Don't pat the burning dog as they say
tries his fav reverse sweep but misses the ball outside off
on the pads, turned through midwicket for a single
just outside off, sliced to backward point. The batsmen get together for a chat
around the off stump line, sliced to short thirdman. They think about the run but the fielder is too quick for them
fullish, on the middle, Dk digs it out back to Mitchell
leans forward to drive it straight for a single
full and straight, he pings his bro
around that off, fuller, run down to third man
short in length around off, DK gets forward to clip it through left of midwicket. I didn't think he had enough wood on that to get it to the boundary but it slips away on this smooth outfield
leans forward to tap the length delivery to covers
high full toss on the off and middle line, a surprised DK punches it to sweeper cover
fetches the full delivery from outside off and sweeps it through midwicket
just outside off stump, edged away to backward point
drifts to the pads and Shaun stays still on the leg stump line and wrists it to fine-leg region
taps it wide of midwicket for a single
Nice and easy. Fulltoss outside leg stump and DK swats it to backward square-leg boundary
in the zone outside off, left alone
full in length on the middle, Paul gets that bat around that front pad and works the ball through midwicket
fuller, slower, outside off, tapped to third man
Slap. The younger brother tries the bouncer and Shaun pulls it to the midwicket boundary. The camera pans to the father
gentle seam-up delivery outside off, DK runs it down to third man
He pushed it towards mid-on for a quick single. The direct hit arrives but he just about manages to get his bat inside the crease. And he will get an overthrow as well
around that off stump, DK pushes it to the off side
pushes this to covers

Rahul bhai has done it again! It skids from short of length outside off. Paul was tempted by the length and went for the cut. But the ball skid on him quickly and he could only slice it to backward point.
short in length and that allows Marsh to turn it past square-leg.
fuller and he immediately beats the bat. Robin collects as the ball slides past the edge
long hop outside off but Marsh doesn't go for any violent shots. He waited for it to arrive and punched it neatly through extra cover.
floated full outside off, driven to long-off

Slightly short in length around off and Marsh cuts it late to third man where Callum Ferguson just about manages to push it back on to the field of play. The back foot was close to the ropes but he just about manages to lift it in the air and evade the rope
What a lovely clean swing of the bat. He leaned forward and creamed it up and over long-on.
How did Robin miss that?! It floated past the edge of the bat - Paul tried to waft it to the off- and Robin didnt move his gloves. It collided with his gloves and rolled to short fine
works this past square-leg for a single
Shout for a catch by Robin Another short delivery and Paul is again late on the pull. The ball flies over the blade and uthappa appeals.
goes for the bouncer and Paul ducks
leans forward to tap this full-length delivery to mid-on for a single
slips to the pads and rolls away. Marsh was trying to whip it to square-leg
similar delivery and this time he pushes it back to the bowler
Ah nice. Pure timing. He leaned forward and seemed to just caress the full-length delivery past the bowler. A single may be or two? but it kept running away
eases this towards mid-off for a quick run
Just about clears midwicket That middle  line is cramping him up. This was short as well and he is late on the pull but manages to clear midwicket
fullish, just outside off, slightly slower, turned down to Mitchell at third man
And again. This one bounces once before it reaches the keeper
in the zone outside off stump, left alone
works this middle and leg line to mid-on for a single

Rahul Sharma has been the man for Pune all through this tournament. he delivers again. Gilchrist went for the slog sweep but perhaps it was too full and he couldn't get much power or elevation on that. He picks out the deep midwicket fielder
pushes this to covers for a quick single

fuller, on the middle, Paul leans forward to defend. There was an appeal just from the keeper. Thought it was a good appeal. Did it hit the pad first or it was the bat hitting the pad? The bowler didn't appeal
short in length, tickled to short fine for a quick single
drags this very short and Gilly misses out. He went for the pull but missed and was hit on the pad.
on the middle stump line, pushed out towards long-on for a single
on the middle and leg and Paul gets his bat around that front pad and works the ball past square-leg for a single
The ball lands just outside off and Paul gets excited. He drives hard but straight to mid-off
On the middle again, Paul stays on the leg stump line, opens the bat-face and steers it to wide third man
on the middle again, tapped to the off side
This one is on the middle stump and straightening- good line and length, Paul steps aside and let it fly over the middle stump line
full in length and on the pads, turned past square-leg for a single. Back to Paul. Will he bowl on the leg and middle line?
Slam dunk! A length delivery well outside off and he reached out to crash it over covers.
spots the bouncer and gets down on his knees to sway away from the line.
goes for a big expansive off drive but misses out. The full delivery tails past the edge.
And again! He stays back to punch this short of length delivery through extra cover. This one went along the ground.
Oh boy! he does love that off side. Bit of width on offer and slightly short as well, he rocked back to shove-slap it over extra cover
short in length on the middle, tucked through midwicket for a single
Blast! He likes the off side eh? This was full and just outside off and he creamed it through extra cover.
fuller, again on the leg stump line and again, Paul misses out. He was late on the flick and the ball rolls off the pad
shortish ball and on the leg side as well, Paul misses out an opportunity there. He edged the pull to his waist
this was closer and straighter, Gilly mistimes the drive to covers. He was on the back foot when he played that drive. Perhaps, it was the ball to go forward to
he lets this go through as well. he was a touch late in doing so as if he thought about going for it. Let's see what happens next ball
One slip in. Pushes it wide outside off stump and Gilly lets it go. He then what he does: walks down the track, taps the pitch, then jogs
Finally, they get a win. The hit over mid-on brought up the winning run.
the bouncer arrives and the batsman gets away from that line
turns this through the on side for a single
moves outside leg and drives to left of mid-off
And again. Quietly tapped to the on side
short in length, defended to the on side of the pitch.
presses back to tap this to midwicket region for a single
leans forward to defend a length delivery
length delivery from round the stumps, Abhishek has a lame poke at it - he was trying to steer it to third man - and gets a thick edge to Gilly.,
lifting delivery from round the stumps, left alone and it has been no balled as it was the second bouncer of the over
on a length around off, defended to the off side
moves outside leg, Shalabh goes for another bouncer and Yuvraj gets a soft top edge and the bowler moves forward to take a dolly
backs away and the bowler slips in a very high bouncer, Yuvraj can't reach it
short in length outside off, forced away to sweeper cover
length delivery angling across Ferguson who stabs it off the inner edge to left of Gilly, who makes a diving stop
Ha! That ball slipped out of the hands! And it bounced twice. Yuvraj waited and blasted it like he was hitting a stationary golf ball. The ball flew to wide midwicket boundary
More gently flighted stuff in the slot and Yuvraj gets down on his knee to hammer it high over midwicket boundary. That bat swing is something to watch.
Imperious! This time it was outside off and he crashed it over covers.
Fabulicious wallop! it was flighted full on middle and leg, in the slot, and Yuvi slam-dunks it high over midwicket boundary. Loverly swing of the bat
rotates the strike by sending the ball down to long-on
pushes this wide down the leg side and Callum doesn't connect with the sweep
floated full on middle and off. turned to midwicket
retains the strike with a drive down to long-on
on the length on the middle and leg, turned to midwicket
gets forward to find long-on for a single

Very nice! gets down on his knee, opens the bat-face and steers this full delivery very neatly to third man boundary. He was shaping for the paddle sweep or so he made it appear before he opened the bat-face and went the other way.
fuller, just outside off, on driven to long-on
gets forward to drive this full-length delivery to covers
just outside off stump, defended to covers
full in length around off, driven to mid-off
slower cutter on the off and middle line, turned to midwicket this time
on the off and middle line, punched back to the bowler
stays back to push this to covers
Clatter! It lands back of length around off and skids towards the off stump. manish goes for the pull but fails to connect.
leans forward to drive to long-off
Fullish outside off, slightly slower, Manish lunges out, adjusts to the lack of place by taking his bottom-hand off the handle and lofts the ball to wide long-on
fullish outside off, sliced off the edge to backward point
fullish, on the leg and middle, lifted uppishly but short of deep midwicket
fetches this short of length delivery from outside off and drags it aerially over to wide long-on region. He lunged and carved
drives this through midwicket for a single
gets forwar dto defend this back to PK and smilingly gets back before PK can throw it back at him
full in length around off, defended to covers
pushes this to mid-on for a single
on the leg stump line, tucked wide of midwicket
gets forward to drive this on the up but straight to short extra cover
edged away It was a full delivery around off and Yuvraj poked at it. The ball ran of the edge and through the vacant slips
Harris hurls another bouncer and Manish ducks
Ryan wins his contest with Robin. It was the bouncer just outside off and Robin topedged his pull shot. The ball landed in the hands of Shalabh who runs in from deep backward square-leg
shortish delivery outside off and Robin almost chops his pull shot to wide long-on region
hops back to swat it through midwicket for a single
around that off stump line, tapped to backward point
leans forward to on drive this to long-on
slower, turning away from the off, pushed out to covers
quicker, flatter, on the middle, Robin shuffles and whips it through square-leg
backs away to ping sweeper cover
flighted outside off stump, full, Manish goes for an forcing shot through the off side but misses out. And so does Adam.
presses back and punches it to right of sweeper cover for a single
on the middle and leg, punched to right of Robin and Bhargav fumbles after getting there!
the bouncer just outside off and Robin is late on the pull. Ryan sledges, Robin sledges back or so it appears to me!
Shot! Full in length and on the middle and Robin glides forward to punch it ever so sweetly over the bowler. Nicely done. He just concentrated on getting the timing right and the placement.
steers this to third man for a single
banged in short just outside off and Manish plays that short-arm stab swat again. He just checks his shot at the point of impact and finds midwicket this time
Robin drives uppishly but clear to the right of mid-on for a sinlge
sprays this down the leg side. Ryan shakes his head as he walks back. Just like he did after he was given out on that high full toss
short in length, on the pads, Manish presses back to clip it to deep square-leg
backs away to cut this to sweeper cover
flighted on a length and Robin eases this to long-off for another single
fuller and Manish pings long-off
lunges forward to force this to long-off. Almost flat-batted it
Thought he was shaping for the slog-sweep but he defends in the end
gets forward to defend this to the off side
full in length outside off and Robin drills that but straight to extra cover
New angle. This comes in from just outside off and Robin plays a rather iffy across-the-line dab and misses. The ball misses the off stump
Crash-pull! It was  short in length and Robin plays the pull shot on the front foot.
Connects this time. And gets a lot of wood on this. It was a short of length delivery angling away from him and Robin flat-bats it to left of his partner
He is playing shot a ball as they say. He tries to pull this from outside off but makes no contact
gets forward and tries to smash this on the up and mistimes it to mid-off

shout for lbw but turned down. Looked close. Was there an inside edge? It was flighted full on the middle and again Manish tried to dab it to the on side and missed. The ball hit him in front. Only thing that would have saved him there was an edge. Hope they show a replay. Replays in: No edge. It landed on middle and slid on towards middle and leg. That's out
floated just outside off, Manish tries to work it to the on side and edges it to his pad
skips down the track for the lofted hit but finds David Hussey at long-on. Ryder was mistiming several of his shots and this one too is no different.
floated full, Ryder sweeps it to short fine
just outside off, punched past the lunging short extra cover fielder for a single
full and around that leg stump line, Ryder mistimes the drive to the on side
in the zone outside off, Manish tries to play the late cut he needs more coaching lessons from his Bangalore legend GRV
short in length outside off, Manish does well to wait for it, open the bat-face and slice it to left of backward point. Bhargav, running across from wide third man, makes a mess of it
mistimes this forcing shot over covers as he makes contact with top of the bat but it lands safely short extra cover

Dropped by Paul at short extra cover. Very tough. Ryder moved outside leg and drilled it so hard at Paul who raised his palms over his head but it burst through his hands and ran away to the boundary!
shortish outside off, but it comes on slowly on this slow track and Ryder mistimes his intended forcing shot through the off. The ball rolls out to mid-on
just outside off, Ryder tries to punch it through covers but doesn't connect. He then goes for a contemplative walk down the track
PK is lucky to get away with this outside-leg delivery. Jesse tried to paddle sweep it but it rolled off his pad
moves outside leg and has a go at this outside-off delivery but misses. PK looks down the track and Jesse practices that shot again
nicely done. It was full and on the middle and leg, Ryder worked his wrists overtime to ping fine-leg boundary. PK stands with his hands on his hips
Imperious! he had enough of nudging and dabbing and lashed out at this. He crashed this length delivery past his partner.
runs this down to third man for a single
dabs this through backward square-leg for a single
low full toss on the middle stump line, flicked to midwicket
banged in short around off stump and Manish swats it to midwicket boundary. He almost stopped the bat at the point of impact
in the zone outside off and Manish is beaten, having a lame poke at it
full in length outside off stump, left alone
around the off stump line, pushed to the off side
edged past backward point. It landed on the middle and shaped away, Manish tried to work it to the on side and got a thick leading edge
again another wide. It was the outswinger again but he has to get the radar right. But the ball is swinging for both PK and Ryan
outswinger from Ryan and he lets it go
fullish, lands just outside leg, moves in to hit the pad. Shout for lbw but it seemed as if it landed just outside leg
And this one shapes back in - in and out, out and in - turned to square-leg
another one that cuts away but it was short in length and Ryder tried to pull it over midwicket but didn't make any contact
this cuts away after landing on the off and middle line, Ryder pushes it to cover point where Mandeep makes a scrambling stop
moves back in towards off and middle after landing on the off stump line, the batsman reacts late and just about stabs it off the inside edge
starts off with a gentle seam-up delivery outside off, left alone
